maya (Comms): Quick postmortem follow-up: we need an owner for the redaction checklist, a consent/sign-off flow for any customer quotes, and a recurring-incident detection step in the postmortem template. Who can take redaction?

kevin (SRE): I can take redaction checklist. Will include rules: strip PII, keys, mask customer hostnames, avoid raw request/response pairs. Ill add a `recurring-pattern` query (past 180d) to the template.

nina (Customer Success): Please include a 72-hour customer summary template and a 3-line "for your customers" blurb we can reuse. CS needs a paste-ready snippet.

oliver (Legal): Legal will require review before any RCA that includes customer-identifying info. I'll draft a short consent template and a simple sign-off chain (SRE -> Legal -> Comms).

incident-bot: Reminder: create task INCIDENT-8901 (customer-comms-followup)  due in 72h.

maya (Comms): Assigning actions: kevin: redaction checklist (48h), maya: statuspage + 72h template (24h), oliver: consent/sign-off doc (72h), nina: CS snippets (3 business days). React with :+1: to accept.

kevin (SRE): :+1:

nina (Customer Success): :+1:

oliver (Legal): :+1:

maya (Comms): Thanks all. I'll create the tracker items and schedule a 20m sync if anyone needs a walkthrough. If an incident involves regulated or on-prem customers, tag me and legal immediately.
